In addition to releasing macOS 27.2 Golden Gate public beta 2, Apple is now rolling out the first Release Candidate (RC) for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Details below.

Older macOS versions continue to receive security updates

In keeping with its usual practice of releasing minor updates for older macOS versions, Apple today released the first Release Candidate for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 without first issuing a general beta.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 at the end of last month, with both versions going through two release candidates before their official launch.

The release notes for the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 simply state that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's update included a security fix for CoreGraphics, as follows:

Apple is likely to release details of the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 sometime in the next few weeks after their official launch, likely alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 carries the build number 24H219, while macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 has the build number 25G320.

Have you spotted any new features or differences in today's release candidates? Let us know in the comments.
